connect.title: Connect to an instance
connect.description: Connect the app to your establishment with the QR code in the panel: Configuration → Devices → Pair a device.
connect.privacy: The app talks only to your Arenile instance: no data goes through Coste360, no telemetry.

revoked.title: Device disconnected
revoked.description: This device's access was revoked from the panel or has expired. Pair it again with a new code.

unpaired.title: Device disconnected
unpaired.description: This device no longer has access to the establishment.

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR code shown in the panel, under Configuration → Devices.
scan.cameraLabel: Camera preview for the QR code
scan.invalid: This is not an Arenile pairing QR code.

permission.title: Camera needed
permission.description: The app uses the camera to read the pairing QR code. Images are neither saved nor sent.
permission.denied: Camera access is denied. Allow it in the device settings or enter the address and code by hand.

manual.title: Address and code
manual.description: You find the address and code in the panel, under Configuration → Devices → Pair a device.

code.label: Pairing code
code.hint: 8 characters: valid once, expires after 5 minutes.

errors.urlInsecure: The address must use https: the device token never travels in clear text.
errors.codeInvalid: The code has 8 characters, for example ABCD-EFGH.

confirm.title: Connect this device?
confirm.description: The link asks to connect the app to the instance {{host}}. Continue only if it is your establishment's address.
confirm.establishment: Establishment named in the QR code: {{name}}

lan_unsupported.title: Desktop local network: coming soon
lan_unsupported.description: This QR code comes from the desktop app in local network mode, which uses its own security certificate. Connecting the app to this mode is coming soon: for now use the panel in the browser.

unreachable.title: Instance unreachable
unreachable.description: Check the device connection and the instance address, then try again.

not_arenile.title: Not an Arenile instance
not_arenile.description: Arenile does not answer at this address. Check the address in the panel.

instance_too_old.title: Arenile needs an update
instance_too_old.description: The instance runs a version of Arenile too old for this app: at least {{min}} is required. Ask whoever runs it to update it.

app_too_old.title: Update the app
app_too_old.description: The instance requires a newer version of the Arenile app. Update it from the App Store or Google Play.

pairing_unavailable.title: Pairing not available
pairing_unavailable.description: The instance does not accept new devices right now. If you use the desktop app, turn on local network mode.

code_invalid.title: Invalid code
code_invalid.description: The code is invalid, expired or already used. Generate a new one in the panel.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.description: Attempts are limited for security. Wait a minute and try again.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.description: The instance gave an unexpected answer. Try again shortly.

invalid_input.title: Invalid link
invalid_input.description: The QR code or link does not contain a valid address and code. Scan the QR code in the panel.

insecure_url.title: Insecure address
insecure_url.description: The address must use https: the device token never travels in clear text.

already_paired.title: Device already connected
already_paired.description: This device is already connected to {{name}}. To connect it to another instance, disconnect it first in Settings.

storage.title: Access not saved
storage.description: The device keychain is not available. Unlock the device and try again.

connection.title: Connection
connection.offlineHint: Check the connection. The app retries as soon as the instance is reachable again.

about.title: About
about.privacy: The app talks only to your instance: no telemetry, no remote updates.

unpair.title: Disconnect this device?
unpair.description: The device immediately loses access to {{name}}. To use it again you will need a new code from the panel.
unpair.offlineDescription: The instance could not be notified. You can disconnect this device only: its access stays in the panel until you revoke it under Configuration → Devices.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.description: An unexpected error occurred in the app.
